meta.description:
Add a lot of content. Most block have info in thier description.
	
	-[[]#ffff00]V.2.13[[]] Core block that let you change team.
	
	-9 new units and 1 turret.
	[[]#ffff00]-V2.16 with 4 new melee units[[]]
	
	-Over simplified factories. and heaters.
	-Super Drill and pump.
	-Op conveyer, unloader, Overdrive x10 speed.
	-And more.
	
	This mod can beat vanilla with [[]#ff0000]64x health and damage[[]] enemy
	Recommend to play vanilla with atleast [[]#ffff00]16x health and damage[[]] enemy and [[]#ffff00]-96% wave timer[[]]
	
	You can watch mod sample on my Youtube. Link in Repo
	[[]#00ff00]This mod have a guide map that show all content[[]]
	
	There are both Serpulo and Erekir version of this mod. make sure to download both mods
